**Finding: MINCOMMIT — compliant (preferred position).** No redline proposed.

The Deerskin/HDI agreement contains no minimum purchase commitment, minimum volume, take-or-pay or shortfall mechanic binding the Company. Our only payment obligation is usage-based: 30% of Net Sales above $11,000 per calendar month, paid on actual sales and reconciled quarterly for refunds and exchanges. HDI carries all build, hosting and promotion costs, so there is not even a fixed monthly fee to characterise.

Two clauses I checked and deliberately did not flag under this rule:
- **§4.2 Termination Payment** — an early-exit fee measured against *actual* trailing Net Sales, and zero unless those Net Sales exceed $800,000. It never obliges us to generate volume, so it is a termination-fee issue, not take-or-pay; flagging it here would double-count the same commercial term.
- **§6.1 Exclusivity** — a restraint on competing Deerskin sites, not a cap on our usage or purchases.
